teams.generatedHint: Teams are balanced by position and level

fields.title: Title
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Lockers available, Alex brings the ball…
fields.coordsHint: We find the map point from the address — no coordinates needed
fields.priceHint: 0 — free game. The total is split evenly between everyone who comes
fields.cancelDeadlineHint: Empty — 6 hours before kick-off. Dropping out later hurts your reputation
fields.minPlayersHint: If fewer sign up by kick-off, the game cancels itself. Default 2
fields.teamCountHint: With 3–4 teams the extras wait their turn and rotate in, like in the quick game

profileGate.title: Profile needed
profileGate.lead: Only players with a profile can create games: the organizer name comes from your profile and all your games live in one place.

success.title: Game created!
success.managedByProfile: The game is linked to your profile: edit and cancel it from any device where you are logged in.

joinForm.title: Sign up
joinForm.asProfile: Profile found: this signup will be linked to {name} @{tag}
joinForm.name: Name
joinForm.waitlisted: No slots left — you're on the waitlist

welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.lead: AVENTO ASCENT is pickup football. Here is what you can do:

items.feedText: a feed of upcoming matches: pick one and sign up in one tap.
items.createText: gather your own: place, time, players and teams.
items.quickText: already on the pitch? Score, timer and standings without sign-ups.
items.profileText: a unique tag: your name in rosters, your games and level.

create.title: Create a profile
create.lead: Fill it in once and sign up for games in one tap. The tag is unique, like in Telegram: it identifies you in rosters and stats.

edit.lead: Your name and tag are visible to other players in rosters

login.title: Already have a profile?
login.lead: Paste the personal code from your other device — the profile moves here.
login.done: Done: the profile is linked to this device

code.title: Personal code
code.lead: The code is how you log in on other devices. Keep it like a password.
code.issuedHint: Save it now: the code is shown once and the old one no longer works.

form.name: Full name
form.tagHint: 3–20 characters: latin letters, digits and “_”, starts with a letter
form.countryHint: Just for looks — shown next to your tag
form.levelHint: Shown in rosters and used to balance teams in the shuffle
form.codeHint: Save it now: the code is shown once and is needed to log in on other devices.

myGames.title: My games
myGames.empty: Nothing yet: join a game from the feed or create your own — everything gathers here.

intro.lead: Match day right here and now: squads, timer, score and table — no sign-up, no internet.
intro.storageHint: The day is saved in this browser automatically

day.title: Match day
day.resetText: The current day will be erased: players, matches and the table. This cannot be undone.

roster.title: Who came
roster.empty: Nobody yet: type a name — and the player is on the list.
roster.tapHint: Tap a player to move them to the next team
roster.waitingHint: Waiting teams come on in queue order

kickoff.autoSub: The waiting team comes on automatically
kickoff.needPlayers: Add players first — score and scorers are recorded per squad

match.scoreHint: Tap a team's score to record a goal
match.outcomeWin: {winner} stays on the pitch, {loser} goes to the back of the queue.
match.drawPrompt: A draw! Play rock-paper-scissors — the loser leaves the pitch.
match.outcomeStay: No queue — the next match is played by the same teams.

standings.title: Table of the day
standings.rules: Win +3, draw +1, loss 0. Sorted by points → goal difference → goals scored.
standings.drawRule: On a draw, teams play rock-paper-scissors — the loser leaves the pitch.

journal.title: Day journal
journal.editHint: Got the score wrong? Fix it with plus/minus — the table recalculates.
journal.autosave: The day is saved on this device automatically

share.title: Share
share.copied: Results copied — paste into a chat
share.tableLine: {rank}. {team} — {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} ({wins} W, {draws} D, {losses} L, {goalsFor}:{goalsAgainst})
share.cardMore: and {count, plural, one {# more match} other {# more matches}}

arrive.title: Who came
arrive.text: Add players by name. A guest? One button — same player, just tagged.

teams.title: Squads
teams.text: From 2 to 4 teams — the extra ones wait their turn. Everyone is spread across the teams; tap a player to move them to the next one.

colors.title: Name and colour
colors.text: The pencil in a team header: rename it and pick a colour from the palette.

kickoff.title: Kick-off
kickoff.text: Choose who plays first. The waiting team comes on automatically.

match.title: Match
match.text: A timer with start and pause, a big score. Tapping a team's score is a goal.

goal.title: Who scored?
goal.text: Scorer and assist — optional, you can record a goal with no scorer. The last goal is easy to undo.

rotation.title: Full time
rotation.text: The winner stays on the pitch, the loser goes to the back of the queue. On a draw — rock-paper-scissors: the loser leaves.

standings.title: Table of the day
standings.text: Win +3, draw +1, loss 0. Sorted by points → goal difference → goals scored.

journal.title: Day journal
journal.text: Every match is saved and any score can be fixed with plus/minus. The whole day lives on this device.

share.title: Sharing
share.text: A text with the match list and the table — into any chat. Plus a result card as a picture.

errors.FORM_REJECTED: The form expired — refresh the page
errors.DUPLICATE_GAME: A similar game already exists nearby at this time
errors.HOST_GAME_LIMIT: You already have active games — finish them first
